title: ETL vs ELT: What's the Real Difference?

scenes.line1: Why are ETL and ELT different?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why ETL and ELT matter in interviews? Which one fits modern data platforms best?
ETL transforms data before loading it into the destination. ELT loads raw data first, then transforms it inside the warehouse.

scenes.label: Cloud
scenes.sub: ELT uses BigQuery or Snowflake for fast, scalable transformations.
scenes.say: Cloud platforms like BigQuery and Snowflake make ELT faster and more scalable by handling transformations after loading.

scenes.question: Where does ELT transform data?
scenes.wrong: Before loading, in an external tool.
scenes.right: After loading, inside the data warehouse.
scenes.say: Interview trap: ELT transforms data after loading, inside the data warehouse—not before.
